title: Nested YAML flow pairs can overwrite the owning row candidate
symptom: Read-only review traced a tagged or anchored nested flow map into a scalar row candidate, allowing standalone format to omit original syntax.

rootCause.summary: Source inspection confirmed same-line nested pair overwrite and incomplete gap validation. The old adapter had no preserved snapshot, so the pre-fix example was traced rather than executed.

requestedOutcome: Refuse ambiguous AST ownership and preserve every non-whitespace byte under standalone format as well as Align; validate unresolved aliases and raw UTF-8.
decisions: Require exact candidate reconstruction from the original line and AST key range.
Verify horizontal-only edits independently of candidate parsing in all structured writes.

actions.description: Reproduce the review input, add regression tests and fix AST/range and byte-preservation checks.
Run independent closure before current candidate packaging.

verification.name: Structured write preservation closure
verification.scope: JSON/YAML adapter and guarded public pipeline
verification.result: Sonnet source closure passed B1-B4; current regressions passed. Subsequent flow-map exclusion and formatter-preflight refinements await final integrated audit.

verification.name: Final candidate integration
verification.scope: Latest flow-map exclusion, raw-byte formatter preflight and installed candidate
verification.result: Current runtime sources passed the 632-test repository check (five existing missing-parser skips, zero failures) and the supplied-snapshot GLM-5.3 audit. The test-only upgrade addition passed a separate six-test run and GLM closure. No public rule or publication approval is implied.

history.summary: Independent Sonnet review traced YAML data loss and requested exact reconstruction, horizontal gap, alias and byte validation.
Scope B was BLOCKED; policy-only scope A passed. No release was approved.
Independent closure passed mandatory adapter/pipeline fixes. Exact pre-fix execution was unavailable; newer regression evidence and later refinements remain separately labeled.

Closed the bounded implementation with the post-native-fix 632-pass repository check, scoped GLM final audit and supplementary hash/test review. Prior failures and pre-closure verification lists are retained; native host acceptance, rule approvals and publication are separate.
